# Ruby Gillis

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)</sub>
- **Role:** Student and future teacher  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034)</sub>

## Appearance

Ruby is a handsome young lady with large, bright-blue eyes, a brilliant complexion, and a plump, showy figure. She has very thick, long, golden-yellow hair, which she wears in braids as a child and styles up while in town. She is considered the handsomest girl of her year at Queen's Academy.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c28 P3](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0003), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## Personality

Ruby is cheerful, good-tempered, and enjoys life's pleasantries, though she is easily inclined to sentimentality and hysterics during tense moments. She is deeply preoccupied with beaus, young men, and romance. Although she dislikes rigorous academic effort, she is generous with her schoolmates, sharing gifts and plums.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c17 P20](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0020), [v1 c23 P16](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0016), [v1 c26 P5](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0005), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c28 P1](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0001), [v1 c30 P6](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0006), [v1 c32 P21](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0021), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003)_

## Abilities

- Charming away warts with a magic pebble  <sub>[v1 c16 P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018)</sub>

## Goals

- To have a beau as soon as she turns fifteen  <sub>[v1 c26 P5](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0005)</sub>
- To teach for two years after Queen's Academy before getting married  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## History

Ruby attends Avonlea school alongside Anne Shirley and her friends. In school, her braid is once pinned to her desk by Gilbert Blythe as a prank, causing a scene that leads to Anne breaking her slate over Gilbert's head. When Mr. Phillips leaves the school, Ruby breaks into tears, inspiring the rest of the girls to cry as well. She joins Anne's story club, adding sentimental romantic elements to her tales, and later plays King Arthur in an outdoor dramatic re-enactment of Elaine. After attending Queen's Academy in Charlottetown to prepare for a teaching license, she frequently walks with Gilbert Blythe. Upon passing her examinations, she secures a teaching position at a school up west.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 c15 P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c28 P11](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0011), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034)_
